settings.title: Shipping Information
settings.content: We ship dental lab supplies across Australia and New Zealand with trusted courier partners to ensure your products arrive safely and on time.

settings.title: Delivery Times
settings.content:
Orders are typically processed within 1-2 business days. Estimated delivery times:

  • Queensland Metro: 2-3 business days
  • Eastern States (NSW, VIC, ACT): 3-5 business days
  • Other Australian States: 4-7 business days
  • Remote Areas: 7-10 business days
  • New Zealand: 7-14 business days

⚠️ Important: Delivery dates are estimates only and are not guaranteed. Delays may occur due to factors beyond our control.

settings.title: Shipping Costs
settings.content:
Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on:

  • Delivery location and carrier zone
  • Total weight and dimensions of your order
  • Selected shipping method

Remote locations may incur additional surcharges. Customers are responsible for all freight and insurance costs.

settings.title: 📦 Order Processing
settings.content:
Business Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am – 6:00pm (AEST)

Orders placed outside business hours, on weekends, or public holidays will be processed on the next business day.

settings.title: Damaged or Missing Items
settings.content:
⚠️ You must report any damage to products within 24 hours of delivery.

If you receive damaged or incorrect items:

  1. Take photos of the damaged packaging and products
  2. Contact us immediately at info@3deltadental.com or 0448 419 050
  3. Provide your order number and photos
  4. Do not discard the packaging until the claim is resolved

settings.title: Returns Policy
settings.content:
We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. Returns are accepted under the following conditions:

  • Products must be unused and in original packaging
  • Returns must be initiated within 30 days of delivery
  • Products must be in resalable condition
  • Special order or custom items are non-returnable

To initiate a return:

  1. Contact us at info@3deltadental.com
  2. Provide your order number and reason for return
  3. Await return authorization and instructions
  4. Ship the item back using a trackable method

settings.title: Refunds
settings.content:
Once we receive and inspect your return:

  • Approved refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days
  • Refunds will be issued to the original payment method
  • Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility unless the return is due to our error
  • Restocking fees may apply to certain products

settings.title: Exchanges
settings.content: If you need to exchange an item for a different size, model, or product, please contact us to arrange the exchange. The fastest way to ensure you get what you want is to return the original item and place a new order.
